sources.title: Qwen3.5 9B OptiQ 4bit — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A quantized text model running at 4-bit precision, trading a small amount of numerical fidelity for significantly reduced memory footprint. It retains the core capabilities of the Qwen3.5 9B base while becoming more accessible on consumer hardware. The compression makes it practical for local deployment, though users may notice subtle quality differences compared to full-precision variants.

sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.5-9B-OptiQ-4bit is a 4-bit mixed-precision quantized version of Qwen3.5-9B optimized for Apple Silicon through sensitivity-aware quantization.
